toolu_01RjPTYNEUfzBZKWNiLKbDLr.summary: All six PowerShell launchd jobs and the daily backup run on the Mac today under /opt/homebrew/bin/pwsh. The Windows-only branches I found are either behind an OS check or never reached, so no live job crashes on a Windows path. One thing does fail every day, and yesterday's audit missed it: the meeting-sync step inside the 06:00 morning cadence has failed on every launchd run since 2026-08-05. The Windows task got FIREFLIES_API_KEY from a system environment variable. On the Mac the key is read from Keychain in ~/.zshrc, which launchd never loads, and the cadence still logs "cadence OK". Two more problems are new. A 2026-08-06 backslash-to-slash port mangled the morning-cadence successProbe regex in jobs.json so it can never match (a hidden fallback the ledger currently covers for). And verify-backup.ps1, which COMMANDS.md calls the "do this, not a guess" backup check, still points at D:\ and C:\, so on the Mac it prints errors and then "VERDICT: PASS". On GitHub, 160 erash11 repos hold 65 workflows and none runs on Windows. The Register-ScheduledTask code search is the full in-git list of Windows schedulers: five KeystoneOS task installers, the adjudicate -Install branch and a CFB reminder pair. No com.keystone plist is committed to any repo.

items.name: Fireflies meeting-sync step inside the morning cadence
items.what_it_does: Each morning runs fireflies-pp-cli sync, then exports the last 14 days of processed meetings into the SecondBrain vault.
items.windows_origin: On Windows the scheduled task picked up FIREFLIES_API_KEY from a user environment variable. meeting-sync SKILL.md:34 still says to set it under 'System Properties -> Environment Variables on Windows'. On the Mac the key is in Keychain, read only by ~/.zshrc (memory project_fireflies-cli-broken-on-mac.md). launchd and pwsh -NoProfile never source that file. The plist EnvironmentVariables holds only PATH.
items.referenced_by: morning-cadence.ps1:8 (daily via com.keystone.morning). The manual /meeting-sync and /fireflies-intake skills use their own scripts/sync.py, not this step.
items.evidence: cadence.log first line after '== Meeting Sync ==', tallied: 37 x 'Error: not authenticated - set FIREFLIES_API_KEY', 7 x 'fireflies-pp-cli not found on PATH' (early Aug), 1 x DB open error. The only 'sync_start' lines are 09-12 interactive runs. Every scheduled run from 10-07 to 10-23 reads 'not authenticated ... fireflies-pp-cli sync failed (exit 1); skipping export this run', yet each day still ends '[2026-10-23T06:01:04] cadence OK'. Invoke-MeetingSync only prints on exit 1, so the cadence never sees the failure. No hit for 'meeting-sync' in the 10-22 audit. I did not check whether Keychain can be read from a gui/ launchd agent.
items.value: Unattended daily meeting import into the vault, which has not run on the Mac for 2.5 months. Port target: 3-4 lines in Invoke-MeetingSync: if $IsMacOS and $env:FIREFLIES_API_KEY is empty, fill it from /usr/bin/security find-generic-password -s FIREFLIES_API_KEY -a $env:USER -w (or run 'fireflies-pp-cli auth set-token' once). Test that the read works from launchd. The other option is to drop the step and keep /fireflies-intake manual. Either way, write to .errors.log when the sync exits non-zero.

items.name: Morning-cadence successProbe regex mangled in the job registry
items.what_it_does: Lets reconcile detect a successful morning cadence from cadence.log when the run ledger has no row (for example, a run started outside run-job.ps1).
items.windows_origin: git log -L shows 3ae2dc4 (2026-07-27) wrote "\\[{DATE}T[^\\]]*\\] cadence OK". da0d964 (2026-08-06, 'post-restore' Windows-to-Mac sync) turned it into "/[{DATE}T[^/]]*/] cadence OK", a backslash-to-slash path conversion applied to a regex.
items.referenced_by: keystone-reconcile.ps1:79 -> run-ledger.ps1 Test-JobCompleteOn -> Test-Probe (fileContains).
items.evidence: pwsh [regex]::IsMatch('[2026-10-23T06:00:00.000-05:00] cadence OK', '/[2026-10-23T[^/]]*/] cadence OK') throws 'Invalid pattern ... at offset 8. [x-y] range in reverse order'. The original pattern returns True. Test-Probe catches the error and returns $false. It is masked today because com.keystone.morning goes through run-job.ps1, which writes an 'ok' ledger row every day (ledger 10-11 to 10-23 all ok). I checked the rest of da0d964's script diff and found no other mangled regex.
items.value: Restore the original escaped pattern (one line). Without it, a cadence started by hand outside run-job.ps1 is invisible to reconcile, which would run it a second time. The same file still carries Windows 'taskName' values ('KeystoneOS Morning', 'KeystoneOS-DailyBackup'). They are only labels and harmless.

And verify-backup.ps1, which COMMANDS.md calls the "do this, not a guess" backup check, still points at D:\ and C:\, so on the Mac it prints errors and then "VERDICT: PASS". On GitHub, 160 erash11 repos hold 65 workflows and none runs on Windows. The Register-ScheduledTask code search is the full in-git list of Windows schedulers: five KeystoneOS task installers, the adjudicate -Install branch and a CFB reminder pair. No com.keystone plist is committed to any repo.

items.name: Fireflies meeting-sync step inside the morning cadence
items.what_it_does: Each morning runs fireflies-pp-cli sync, then exports the last 14 days of processed meetings into the SecondBrain vault.
items.windows_origin: On Windows the scheduled task picked up FIREFLIES_API_KEY from a user environment variable. meeting-sync SKILL.md:34 still says to set it under 'System Properties -> Environment Variables on Windows'. On the Mac the key is in Keychain, read only by ~/.zshrc (memory project_fireflies-cli-broken-on-mac.md). launchd and pwsh -NoProfile never source that file. The plist EnvironmentVariables holds only PATH.
items.referenced_by: morning-cadence.ps1:8 (daily via com.keystone.morning). The manual /meeting-sync and /fireflies-intake skills use their own scripts/sync.py, not this step.
items.evidence: cadence.log first line after '== Meeting Sync ==', tallied: 37 x 'Error: not authenticated - set FIREFLIES_API_KEY', 7 x 'fireflies-pp-cli not found on PATH' (early Aug), 1 x DB open error. The only 'sync_start' lines are 09-12 interactive runs. Every scheduled run from 10-07 to 10-23 reads 'not authenticated ... fireflies-pp-cli sync failed (exit 1); skipping export this run', yet each day still ends '[2026-10-23T06:01:04] cadence OK'. Invoke-MeetingSync only prints on exit 1, so the cadence never sees the failure. No hit for 'meeting-sync' in the 10-22 audit. I did not check whether Keychain can be read from a gui/ launchd agent.
items.value: Unattended daily meeting import into the vault, which has not run on the Mac for 2.5 months. Port target: 3-4 lines in Invoke-MeetingSync: if $IsMacOS and $env:FIREFLIES_API_KEY is empty, fill it from /usr/bin/security find-generic-password -s FIREFLIES_API_KEY -a $env:USER -w (or run 'fireflies-pp-cli auth set-token' once). Test that the read works from launchd. The other option is to drop the step and keep /fireflies-intake manual. Either way, write to .errors.log when the sync exits non-zero.

items.name: Morning-cadence successProbe regex mangled in the job registry
items.what_it_does: Lets reconcile detect a successful morning cadence from cadence.log when the run ledger has no row (for example, a run started outside run-job.ps1).
items.windows_origin: git log -L shows 3ae2dc4 (2026-07-27) wrote "\\[{DATE}T[^\\]]*\\] cadence OK". da0d964 (2026-08-06, 'post-restore' Windows-to-Mac sync) turned it into "/[{DATE}T[^/]]*/] cadence OK", a backslash-to-slash path conversion applied to a regex.
items.referenced_by: keystone-reconcile.ps1:79 -> run-ledger.ps1 Test-JobCompleteOn -> Test-Probe (fileContains).
items.evidence: pwsh [regex]::IsMatch('[2026-10-23T06:00:00.000-05:00] cadence OK', '/[2026-10-23T[^/]]*/] cadence OK') throws 'Invalid pattern ... at offset 8. [x-y] range in reverse order'. The original pattern returns True. Test-Probe catches the error and returns $false. It is masked today because com.keystone.morning goes through run-job.ps1, which writes an 'ok' ledger row every day (ledger 10-11 to 10-23 all ok). I checked the rest of da0d964's script diff and found no other mangled regex.
items.value: Restore the original escaped pattern (one line). Without it, a cadence started by hand outside run-job.ps1 is invisible to reconcile, which would run it a second time. The same file still carries Windows 'taskName' values ('KeystoneOS Morning', 'KeystoneOS-DailyBackup'). They are only labels and harmless.
